# 🎉 Play Now & Get a Free Bird Item! 🐦

Play now and get the Bird for free in the 'Shop'—available for a limited time!

Join our 'Discord' community and tell us:
-  https://discord.gg/7RQmEaPgmY

Which drone model you’d like

What kind of map atmosphere you want

We’ll randomly select players and actually create them in-game!
[media]

# 🚀 Have a Mode in Mind?
Let us know!
We’re currently planning to add a Racing Mode next.

Have fun, and… Gotcha~! 😎

# 🕹️🚁Practice flying your drone
Learn the drone controls anytime, at your own pace.

[media]

# 🔓Unlock and choose the drone you want
Unlock new drones in the shop and play with a variety of drones.
[media]

# 🎯🚓Find and capture the suspect
Search for the suspect who matches the figure’s appearance and pose.
You’ll need to carefully distinguish between many characters across a large map.
[media]
